resources.string: Here are the changes in this version. Your settings are preserved.
Smaller launcher symbol: more room around the n inside circular and other adaptive masks.
With app icons enabled, the home hub uses the noduS app icon instead of a dot.
Notification presence uses the same slow pulse for either the dot or the noduS icon. Fixed and off modes remain available.
In airplane mode, the airplane icon replaces signal bars. Wi-Fi can still appear when connected.
